evidence: Ov. M. 12.480, of hail rebounding from a roof (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: What the ball does: to spring back, to rebound (Lewis & Short). To bounce a ball is to throw it so that it springs back, as in the example. Morgan–Owens has the noun resultus, a bounce, from Vives.

phrases.latin: pilam ad terram jacere ut resiliat
phrases.english: to bounce the ball (to throw it at the ground so that it springs back)
